profile.description: Unqualified diagnostic cross-v2 serving screen for an 8-physical-core AMD EPYC 7B13 Milan host. This records the applicable shared server flags; it is not a production recommendation and does not claim scaling beyond this host.

hardware.notes: GCP host used for an 8-core diagnostic screen. DRAM read was approximately 62 GB/s at 8T and simultaneous GEMV retained near-linear aggregate scaling; these are host observations, not a larger-Milan sizing result.

precision.talker_weights: int8; AVX2 FMA widen/dequant GEMV reference
precision.speech_decoder_weights: fp32/BLAS control; AVX2 INT8 decoder unavailable
precision.activations: backend-native preparation with AVX2 FMA reference leaves
precision.gemm_backend: OpenBLAS prefill/decoder; AVX2 FMA matvec reference

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: park idle OpenBLAS workers instead of spinning against the engine pool

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: must remain absent so the engine owns BLAS sizing

QWEN_CP_PREFILL2.why: experimental CP two-position prefill; opt-in on AVX2

QWEN_DECODER_BATCH.why: per-item decoder control used by the cross-v2 screen

QWEN_POOL_SPIN.why: x86 reference spin value; not claimed optimal for larger Milan

QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT.why: request native prefill policy; AVX2 gate correctly resolves to FP32/SGEMM fallback

QWEN_SD_INT8.why: requested but capability gate resolves OFF on AVX2

QWEN_SD_RAG_MIN_PANELS.why: shared decoder threshold; inactive for the per-item AVX2 fallback

qualification.workload: OSS qwen3-tts-0.6b, Ryan speaker, C1 closed-loop, 2 minutes measured after 10 seconds warmup, same bank and 4x8-capable single worker on control and treatment.
qualification.interpretation: PARTIAL: cross-v2 flags reduced TTFA p95 by 38% and safe-start p95 by 26%, but worsened STREAM p95 from 0.888 to 0.988 and introduced 10% stall@250/@500 in this short C1 sample. Do not promote; remeasure on a larger Milan before selecting a product profile.

status_matrix.IMPLEMENTED: YES; configuration records the tested flag set
status_matrix.PARITY_VERIFIED: NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_FLAG_BUNDLE; serving run had zero errors and runtime gates selected valid AVX2 fallbacks
